sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A WEAK UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH FROM THE NRN ROCKIES TO THE LOWER CO VALLEY WILL MOVE EWD AND LIKELY EXTEND FROM THE NRN TO THE SRN HIGH PLAINS BY 00Z/FRI. THIS WILL DISPLACE THE RIDGE CURRENTLY EXTENDING ACROSS MOST OF THE PLAINS TO THE MS VALLEY AND EVENTUALLY TO THE GREAT LAKES/MIDWEST. PRIMARY SURFACE CYCLONE SHOULD DEVELOP INTO THE MID-MO VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON WITH A PAIR OF ATTENDANT TROUGHS EXTENDING NWD INTO THE ERN DAKOTAS AND SWWD INTO THE TX PANHANDLE. ARCING WARM FRONT SHOULD GRADUALLY RETREAT NEWD ACROSS NRN MO AND INTO FAR SRN IA DURING THE EVENING.

sections.title: LOWER/MID-MO VALLEY TO THE SRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: A MARGINAL RISK FOR SEVERE HAIL WILL LIKELY EXIST DURING THE MORNING WITH LINGERING ELEVATED CONVECTION NE OF THE WARM FRONT IN THE LOWER/MID-MO VALLEY. SURFACE-BASED TSTM DEVELOPMENT SHOULD BE RELATIVELY MORE WIDESPREAD ACROSS THE CNTRL/SRN PLAINS COMPARED TO WED AFTERNOON OWING TO FAVORABLE TIMING OF A BROAD UPPER-LEVEL TROUGH APPROACHING THE CNTRL CONUS. LARGE-SCALE ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THIS TROUGH AND CONVERGENCE ALONG THE AFOREMENTIONED SURFACE BOUNDARIES SHOULD PROVE SUFFICIENT FOR REMOVAL OF A CAPPING EML...RESULTING IN ISOLATED TO SCATTERED TSTMS FORMING ACROSS ERN NEB/KS DURING THE LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ALONG WITH SURFACE HEATING WILL CONTRIBUTE TO LARGE POTENTIAL INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE LIKELY REACHING 2000-3000 J/KG FROM SERN NEB INTO WRN OK. A STRENGTHENING KINEMATIC PROFILE THAT VEERS WITH HEIGHT SHOULD INITIALLY YIELD SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL. WITH TIME...CONGLOMERATION OF CELLULAR COLD POOLS COULD YIELD UPSCALE GROWTH INTO AN MCS SHIFTING EWD INTO PARTS OF MO AND SRN IA WITH RISKS FOR SEVERE HAIL/WIND AND PERHAPS A TORNADO OR TWO. FARTHER SW...GUIDANCE IS FAIRLY CONSISTENT THAT IN THE EVENING...ONE OR MORE AREAS OF C

sections.title: SERN NEB/SWRN IA/ERN KS/WRN MO
sections.text: MORNING WATER VAPOR LOOPS SHOW A SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING ACROSS UT INTO CO THIS MORNING. THIS FEATURE IS EXPECTED TO EMERGE ACROSS THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS BY AFTERNOON...AND EASTWARD INTO THE MO VALLEY TONIGHT. AHEAD OF THE SYSTEM...SOUTHERLY LOW LEVEL WINDS WILL MAINTAIN DEWPOINTS IN THE 50S TO LOWER 60S. FULL SUNSHINE AND COOL TEMPERATURES ALOFT WILL YIELD AN AXIS OF 2000-3000 J/KG MLCAPE VALUES FROM SOUTHEAST NEB INTO NORTHWEST OK. PRESENT INDICATIONS ARE THAT CLUSTER OF ONGOING THUNDERSTORMS OVER NORTHERN MO WILL SLOWLY WEAKEN LATER THIS MORNING...BUT LEAVE A REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY TO HELP FOCUS RE-DEVELOPMENT OF STORMS THIS AFTERNOON. MODEL SOLUTIONS SUGGEST THE MOST LIKELY AREA OF DEVELOPMENT WILL BE OVER SOUTHWEST IA AND SOUTHEAST NEB...WITH STORMS SPREADING SOUTHEASTWARD INTO PARTS OF KS/MO DURING THE EVENING. FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOW AMPLE CAPE AND SUFFICIENT DEEP LAYER SHEAR FOR SLOW-MOVING SUPERCELL STORMS CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. CAPE VALUES WILL BE LARGER THAN YESTERDAY...AND LARGE SCALE FORCING WILL BE STRONGER. THIS MAY RESULT IN MORE NUMEROUS STORMS THAN ON WEDNESDAY. LOW LEVEL SHEAR WILL NOT BE PARTICULARLY STRONG...BUT MAY BE SUFFICIENT FOR

sections.title: SRN KS/NWRN OK
sections.text: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS MAY ALSO DEVELOP SOUTHWESTWARD ALONG THE SURFACE BOUNDARY INTO NORTHWEST OK AND THE TX PANHANDLE THIS EVENING. LOW/MID LEVEL WINDS WEAKEN WITH SOUTHWARD EXTENT...SUGGESTING THE MOST LIKELY AREA FOR MORE ORGANIZED SEVERE STORMS WOULD BE ACROSS SOUTH-CENTRAL KS AND NORTHWEST OK. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS SHOULD BE THE MAIN THREATS. ..HART/HURLBUT.. 03/29/2012

sections.title: CENTRAL PLAINS/LOWER MO VALLEY
sections.text: WATER VAPOR IMAGERY SHOWS AN ELONGATED EWD MOVING SHORT WAVE TROUGH EXTENDING FROM THE NRN HIGH PLAINS SSWWD INTO AZ. WITHIN THE TROUGH...A STRONGER VORTICITY MAX OVER SERN WY IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE EWD INTO CENTRAL NEB BY THIS EVENING...WITH AN ASSOCIATED BAND OF STRONGER MID/UPPER LEVEL WESTERLY WINDS TRANSLATING ACROSS THE CENTRAL PLAINS. AT THE SURFACE...A LOW OVER N CENTRAL KS IS FORECAST TO MOVE INTO NERN KS LATER THIS AFTERNOON AND PROGRESS ACROSS NRN MO TOWARD SERN IA TONIGHT. A WARM FRONT CURRENTLY EXTENDS ESEWD FROM THE LOW ACROSS SRN MO INTO THE TN VALLEY...WHILE A DRY LINE TRAILS SWD INTO W TX. EXTENSIVE LOW CLOUDS NORTH OF THE WARM FRONT OVER NRN PARTS OF KS AND MO /AND CONVECTION OVER NRN MO/ MAY LIMIT THE NWD MOVEMENT OF THE WARM FRONT THIS AFTERNOON...ALTHOUGH RECENT SATELLITE TRENDS SUGGEST CLOUDS MAY DIMINISH MORE QUICKLY OVER N CENTRAL/NERN KS AND ALLOW THE FRONT TO LIFT TO NEAR THE NEB BORDER THIS AFTERNOON. 12Z AREA SOUNDINGS INDICATE STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES ASSOCIATED WITH AN ELEVATED MIXED LAYER REMAINING OVER THE AREA. STRONG DIURNAL HEATING SOUTH OF THE WARM FRONT WILL ENHANCE THE THERMAL CONTRAST ACROSS THE BOUNDARY. SURFACE DEW POINTS IN THE LOW-MID

sections.title: SRN KS INTO WRN OK
sections.text: SCATTERED STORMS MAY GRADUALLY DEVELOP SWWD ALONG THE DRY LINE ACROSS S CENTRAL KS INTO WRN OK BY THIS EVENING AS WEAK LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE COUPLED WITH STRONG HEATING LOCALLY WEAKENS THE CAP. ALTHOUGH WINDS ALOFT/VERTICAL SHEAR WEAKEN WITH SWD EXTENT AND CONVECTIVE COVERAGE WILL BE MORE ISOLATED...STRONGER CELLS WILL BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING LARGE HAIL AND STRONG WIND GUSTS THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS.

sections.title: SC
sections.text: STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP THIS AFTERNOON IN ADVANCE OF THE COLD FRONT MOVING SWD FROM NC TOWARD SC. STRONG HEATING WILL CONTRIBUTE TO A RELATIVELY DEEP MIXED LAYER WITH DCAPE VALUES APPROACHING 1000 J/KG. THE THERMODYNAMIC STRUCTURE SUGGESTS POTENTIAL FOR DOWNDRAFTS TO BE ENHANCED WITH A THREAT FOR A FEW DOWNBURSTS...ALONG WITH MARGINAL HAIL...THIS AFTERNOON INTO THE EVENING. ..WEISS/KERR.. 03/29/2012

sections.title: CORN BELT TO NWRN OK
sections.text: GREATEST RISK FOR EMBEDDED SUPERCELL STRUCTURES WILL PERSIST WITH CONVECTIVE CLUSTER PRESENTLY NE OF THE SURFACE CYCLONE ALONG THE NERN KS/SERN NEB BORDER. UPSCALE GROWTH APPEARS TO BE UNDERWAY AS FORCING STRENGTHENS...SUGGESTING A SMALL MCS SHOULD EVOLVE EWD ALONG AND NE OF A SLOW-MOVING WARM FRONT ACROSS NWRN TO E-CNTRL MO. STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND A FEED OF MLCAPE AROUND 2000 J/KG PER 00Z TOP RAOB SHOULD REMAIN FAVORABLE FOR LARGE HAIL INITIALLY...TRANSITIONING TO A SLIGHTLY ELEVATED MCS WITH ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL/WIND THREATS. SEE MCD 385 FOR ADDITIONAL SHORT-TERM INFORMATION. FARTHER SW...CONVECTIVE CLUSTERS OVER NWRN OK AND NEAR ICT SHOULD WEAKEN WITH TIME AS MODERATE MLCIN SAMPLED IN 00Z OUN/SGF RAOBS FURTHER INCREASES.

sections.title: LOWER RIO GRANDE VALLEY
sections.text: SWWD-MOVING TSTM CLUSTER WILL POSE A CONTINUED RISK FOR ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL/WIND DURING THE NEXT HOUR GIVEN SUFFICIENT DEEP-LAYER SHEAR FOR SUPERCELL STRUCTURES PER 00Z BRO RAOB. ..GRAMS.. 03/30/2012
